name: House Of Legends Barbershop
metaTitle: House Of Legends Barbershop: Barber in Riverview
metaDescription: House Of Legends Barbershop at 11503 Ivy Flower Loop in Riverview lists a $30 haircut and a $25 kids cut. The booking page says there are no walk-ins.

publish.hoursNote: The booking page showed one day's hours, not a full week. Book ahead. The page says no walk-ins.

facts: House Of Legends Barbershop, Riverview. Address 11503 Ivy Flower Loop, Riverview, FL 33578. Phone (813) 784-5463. The listed website is a Booksy booking page: https://booksy.com/en-us/141892_pjbarber_barber-shop_15755_riverview.
Prices on that page: Reg Haircut $30.00 for 1h, eyebrow optional at no extra charge. MVP Haircut with eyebrows and beard or goatee $40.00 for 1h. Kids haircut under 10 years old $25.00 for 1h.

The page says no walk-ins, and asks guests to be at the barbershop 10 minutes before the appointment. Amenities listed: parking space, credit cards accepted, accessible for people with disabilities, Wi-Fi.

A single business-hours line showed 09:00 AM - 06:00 PM for the day the page was opened, including a Nov 25, 2026 line. That is not a published weekly schedule. Review scores on the page are not used.

Nearby from our coordinates: Circle K 0.75 miles at 11401 US-301, Riverview, slug circle-k-7. TGH Urgent Care powered by Fast Track (Riverview) 0.82 miles at 11406 US-301, slug fast-track-urgent-care-center.

faq.q: How much is a haircut on the booking page?
faq.a: A regular haircut is listed at $30.00 for 1 hour. The kids cut, under 10, is $25.00. The MVP cut with beard or goatee is $40.00.
The booking page says no walk-ins and asks you to arrive 10 minutes early.
The page we read showed one day at 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, not the whole week. Book on the site or call (813) 784-5463.
